case.title: Enumerator point about 5.6 m north of Kondele's northern edge (lat -0.06995 vs edge -0.07)

submissions.open_text: Queue at the kiosk is long every morning before school.
Borehole water tastes salty during the dry months.

case.why: Kondele spans lat -0.09 to -0.07. -0.06995 is greater than -0.07, so the point is 0.00005 deg (about 5.6 m) north of the edge and outside. An implementation that rounds coordinates to 3 decimals (giving -0.070), adds a GPS tolerance buffer, or compares negative latitudes by absolute value (0.06995 < 0.07 looks 'inside') would wrongly stay silent. Only 2 submissions 85 min apart, so same_spot and burst cannot fire; texts share no content words; durations above 12 min; daytime; one contributor per device; no transcripts.

review: Corrected in review: 5.6 m outside is inside GPS error (the 15 m floor).
